title: Colombian coffee smallholder, two dry seasons (English)
profile_note: Sample producer: coffee, 1st Grade cooperative, Cauca, Colombia. Regional data and peer examples exist, so the answer has full evidence.

turns.message: It hasn't rained like it used to. We've had two seasons of very irregular rain and last year's coffee harvest dropped a lot.
It started at the end of 2024. We lost about a third of the crop. Some of us planted more shade trees in the coffee, but it wasn't enough.

args.text: It wasn't a third, it was almost half the harvest.

intake_replies: We tried planting more shade trees and saving water in tanks, but the rain just did not come.
